name: ribbon-drift
title: Ribbon Drift
description: Scroll-driven ribbon gallery where image strips drift horizontally at alternating speeds, revealing project names with GSAP SplitText on scroll.

changelog.summary: Removed images, projectNames, ribbons, amplitude, and pauseOnHover — content is now always drawn from the built-in image/name pool. Added imageSize and showNames, and reset ribbonColor's default back to black to match the original text-fill look.

Fixed the demo page rendering nothing (it wasn't wired to the effect's DemoContent). Wired up ribbons, driftSpeed, amplitude, ribbonColor, and pauseOnHover for real: ribbons overrides the image/name pool, driftSpeed and amplitude scale the scroll-timeline durations and strip drift distances, ribbonColor tints the section-break reveal text, and pauseOnHover freezes the scroll-linked timelines while hovering.

Added images and projectNames as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested props (ribbons, driftSpeed, amplitude, ribbonColor, pauseOnHover) didn't match this component's real API, so they were replaced with the props RibbonDriftComp actually accepts.

Removed the reduced-motion animation branching entirely - the scroll-driven reveal, hover spli.ts, and strip transitions now always run identically to the default; only the reduced-motion notice remains conditional.

Synced the docs-mirror RibbonDriftComp with the registry copy's full prefers-reduced-motion support (static layout, X-only strip exi.ts, fade-based intro/hover transitions) - the mirror was missing all of it.
Restored the mobile full-height wrapper rule (max-md:h-full) that was lost to a max-snm typo; docs copy typo corrected to max-sm.

props.name: imageSize
props.description: Scale multiplier applied to the ribbon images.

props.name: showNames
props.description: Shows the project name on hover.
